defect: The fix adds disabled-state colouring (itemDisabledStyle) to Choice and CheckBox drawing; this change only added the selected checkmark, drawn in white like the existing text.
reason: No enabled/disabled concept existed at this change (no IsEnabled or itemDisabledStyle in ui/), so the fix adds a rendering feature rather than repairing a defect from this change.

defect: The fix only renames View::GetEnabled() to IsEnabled() at the call sites in GetDirectionScore and FindNeighbor.
reason: The accessor body is unchanged (return enabled_), so this is a pure rename with identical behaviour.

defect: The new edit-confirm filter `confirmed = confirmed && IsKeyPressed(Enter) || IsKeyPressed(KeypadEnter)` parses as (confirmed && Enter) || KeypadEnter, so a keypad Enter press commits the watch edit even when InputText did not report confirmation.
reason: The fix adds the missing parentheses on exactly the line this change introduced; the %f-with-integer line it also touches predates the change.

defect: Removing the flip convention left BlitFramebuffer computing source and destination Y with the old bottom-up flip (renderHeight - ...) plus the flip block, so framebuffer blits come out vertically wrong under the new orientation.
reason: The follow-up 'Fix a few more flips' 14 minutes later completes this change's flip removal; the blit Y math was correct before and became wrong only through this change's convention switch, although the repaired lines themselves were left untouched by it (its one edited line there, the non-blit DrawActiveTexture call, was already right).

defect: The fix drops the Windows MAC-address text prompt and restores the generic Change Mac Address choice; the Win32 build break it mentions came from the intermediate commit c1fc04e that renamed localMacAddress to sMACAddress.
reason: The change's code compiled and worked when written; the build break came from a later rename and removing the prompt is a design decision.

defect: The fix turns IR_PROFILING back off and adds the missing IRBlockCache::GetBlockProfileStats override; this change only switched the profiling define on.
reason: Enabling the debug define was a deliberate temporary configuration toggle; the real profiling bug (no override, stats always zero) came from the earlier profiling commit ba1ced7.

defect: The new JitBlockCacheDebugInterface::GetBlockProfileStats is a non-pure virtual that returns empty stats, and the IR block cache, which reports SupportsProfiling(), never overrides it, so profiling always shows zero executions and time.
reason: The fix makes the method pure virtual and adds the IR and native overrides, repairing the silent zero-stats default this change introduced together with its incomplete IRJit wiring.

defect: The fix clamps the Prev/Next block buttons to the list bounds; in this change stepping past either end only falls back to the block list view because UpdateDisasm range-checks currentBlock_.
reason: No crash or wrong result follows from the change's code, and unbounded ++/-- on the block index predates it (OnPrevBlock/OnNextBlock), so the fix is a usability refinement.

defect: The fix renames the local variable DefaultLang to defaultLang.
reason: Naming-style change with identical behaviour.

defect: sceCccUTF8toSJIS and sceCccUTF16toSJIS check jis2ucsTable although they look up ucs2jisTable, and sceCccUTF16toUTF8 needlessly refuses to convert without a table.
reason: The fix corrects exactly these table checks the change added; each function visibly guards the wrong table in the diff.

defect: The fix makes processFinishDialog remove the finished dialog wherever it sits in the stack and checks for an empty stack before stack_.back(); this change only added a null check on the caller and the transparent-layer flag.
reason: Both repaired problems (popping the top instead of the finished dialog, back() before the empty check) existed before this change.

defect: The fix deletes the QCOM binning-control block, whose glHint call had already been commented out by ab759a9 after crash reports, and drops the extension detection in native.
reason: When the fix landed, the code this change added was already inert, so in this file the fix removes dead code rather than repairing a live defect.

defect: CreateDownloadTempBuffer now creates the readback FBO with nvfb->width instead of nvfb->bufferWidth, so it is too small for the blit, which covers renderWidth = bufferWidth.
reason: The fix changes exactly this added CreateFramebuffer call to bufferWidth; seeing the mismatch needs the nvfb setup in FramebufferCommon.cpp.

defect: The fix tweaks the pause screen's scroll margins alongside a layout bugfix in native; this change only moved GamePauseScreen into its own file.
reason: Code move followed by a layout tweak; no defect from this change is repaired.

defect: The PAKFILE2.BIN bypass writes `bootpath == ...` (a comparison) instead of an assignment, so the alternative boot file is never selected.
reason: The fix changes == to = on the line this change added; the typo is plain in the diff.

defect: UpdateRunLoop is declared as taking a GraphicsContext* although its parameter is the InputState*, so the declaration matches neither the definition nor the callers.
reason: The fix corrects the parameter type on the line this change edited; the parameter name input_state makes the mismatch visible.

defect: The macOS branch tests PPSSPP_PLATFORM(MACOS), which ppsspp_config.h never defines (it defines PPSSPP_PLATFORM_MAC), so macOS gets no SContext and no MACHINE_CONTEXT_SUPPORTED.
reason: The fix renames the macro to MAC on the line this change added; spotting it requires ppsspp_config.h.

defect: The fix replaces the stopgap !IOS && !UWP guard around HandleFault with the MACHINE_CONTEXT_SUPPORTED macro introduced by the same-day MachineContext.h refactor.
reason: Follow-up cleanup in a series of build fixes; the guard did not break any configuration that built before it.

defect: SetError switches PointerWrap to MODE_MEASURE for any error including ERROR_WARNING, so a savestate that only raises a warning (such as a version mismatch) aborts loading instead of being tried.
reason: The fix changes the condition to error > ERROR_WARNING in the SetError this change added; the separate WARNING and FAILURE levels make the mistake visible in the diff.

defect: The fix adds Android-specific assert reporting through __android_log_assert and makes _assert_ active outside debug builds.
reason: New reporting feature; _assert_ was already debug-only before this change, so nothing it added is repaired.

defect: The fix sets Color565 alpha to 255 instead of 1.0f and turns the 5551 alpha literals back from 255.0f/0.0f into integers.
reason: The 565 alpha bug predates this change, and the change's float literals convert to the same u8 values.

defect: The fix adds sector-padded reads, FILEMOVE_END seeking and sce_lbn GetFileInfo to the virtual disc file system; this change only moved that code into its own file.
reason: Pure move: the repaired code was identical in DirectoryFileSystem.cpp before the change.

defect: The fix rewrites the 64-bit dirty flags as an enum : uint64_t instead of bit-index enums plus FLAG_BIT64 macros.
reason: Both forms give the same bit values and DIRTY_ALL (-1) converts to all ones in a u64, so this is a cleaner redesign, not a repaired defect.

defect: The rewritten DEBUG_LOG in sceFontGetFontInfoByIndexNumber keeps four format specifiers but now passes only three arguments, which is undefined behaviour.
reason: The fix corrects this format string, which the change produced by dropping an argument; the fix's main subject (sceFontGetFontList error codes) is unrelated older code.

defect: The fix restricts the execinfo-based backtrace code to __linux__ so the file builds on FreeBSD.
reason: Porting to a platform that was not supported then; on the configurations in use (Linux, MSVC) the code built and worked.

defect: The fix includes netinet/in.h on FreeBSD so that sockaddr_in is declared.
reason: FreeBSD portability added later; the header was fine on the platforms supported when it was written.

defect: For texgen modes other than texture coordinates, the new code sets uvscaleoff to only the texture size factor, dropping the uScale/vScale and vertex-format rescale factor that were applied in every mode before.
reason: The fix deletes exactly these added lines (blame confirms bf1e076) and applies uScale*factor*widthFactor in all modes; judging it needs the PSP texgen semantics and the vertex shader.

defect: The fix reorders the DrawBuffer constructor's initializer list to silence -Wreorder.
reason: Initialization-order warning only; program_(0) does not depend on other members.

defect: The fix reorders the Connection (resolved_ before sock_) and Download initializer lists to silence -Wreorder.
reason: Warning only; the initializers are independent constants, so behaviour is unchanged.

defect: The fix reorders PopupScreen's initializer list (box_ before title_) to silence -Wreorder.
reason: Warning only; no behaviour change.

defect: The fix reorders Choice's initializer lists and adds the missing centered_(false) to the ImageID constructor.
reason: The reordering is warning-only, and centered_ was already left uninitialized in the ImageID constructor before this change.

defect: The fix changes the non-FFmpeg fallback return of writeVideoImage and writeVideoImageWithRange from true to 0 and moves the m_videopts increment ahead of the null checks in stepVideo.
reason: Without FFmpeg m_pFrame is never allocated, so the early return makes the change's `return true` unreachable; the m_videopts ordering predates this change.

defect: For ATRAC3+ the change sets codecOpen_ = true even when atrac3p_alloc returns nullptr (missing block_align or bad channel count), so Decode then calls atrac3p_decode_frame with a null context and crashes.
reason: The fix makes Decode bail out when the codec failed to open; the crash on bad AT3+ parameters began with this change (reshaped but not fixed by b35b351), and seeing that atrac3p_alloc can fail needs atrac3plusdec.cpp.

defect: The new BufferedLineReader keeps trailing carriage returns, so .expected files with CRLF line endings never match the emulator output and every such test fails.
reason: The fix trims CR/LF in the line reader this change introduced; whether the expected files contain carriage returns is outside the diff.

defect: The fix changes the videoPixelMode bound check from > to >= to close an off-by-one read of modeBpp.
reason: The off-by-one predates this change, which only added an (int) cast to the same comparison.

defect: The new predict_nr bounds check divides by sizeof(s8), giving 10 instead of the 5 rows of f, so predict_nr values 5 to 9 still index past the filter table.
reason: The fix changes the divisor to sizeof(f[0]) in the check this change added; the 2-D array makes the error visible in the diff.

defect: The fix replaces the literal UBO-offset count 3 with ARRAY_SIZE(dynamicUBOOffsets) after a later commit shrank that array to two entries.
reason: At this change the array still had three entries matching the pre-existing literal 3; the mismatch arose later, not from this change.

defect: The fix shrinks VkRenderData::draw.uboOffsets from three to two entries.
reason: This change moved the struct unchanged out of VulkanRenderManager.h; three slots were right while three UBO offsets were used, and the fix adapts to a later reduction to two.

defect: The fix corrects the UI label typo 'Button Perference' to 'Button Preference'.
reason: Cosmetic text fix, and the same misspelt key already existed before this change.

defect: Lowering the colour-test rounding offset in roundTo255thv from 0.5/255 to 0.49/255 makes colour-test comparisons fail for some colours, producing a black box in Super Robot Taisen Z Hakaihen.
reason: The fix reverts the colour-test half of exactly this change (keeping the alpha-test tweak); the effect only shows at runtime with specific game data.
